root_idea.summary: The root centers on measuring or estimating one thing by reference to another; قَوْسٌ is associated with the bow and with measures such as the arm or cubit.
root_idea.development: The measurement principle extends to comparison and قياس, while the bow's curved form motivates derived meanings for bending and for various bow-shaped objects and structures.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular citation form قَوْسٌ; the Quran occurrence is its dual form قَوْسَيْنِ.

senses.definition: A bow, the weapon from which arrows are shot.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic occurrence, the noun appears in the dual expression قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ, invoking the bow as the measure of proximity.

senses.definition: In قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ, a distance or measure equivalent to two bows; the expression is also explained as two cubits.
senses.usage_conditions: This is a fixed Quranic measurement construction in which قَوْسَيْنِ is the dual form of قَوْسٌ. The alternative cubit interpretation belongs specifically to the interpretation of this expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To measure one thing by another comparable thing; to compare or assess it by reference to another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used both for physical measurement and for mental comparison; the form and its related measurement nouns have variant vowel patterns.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make something bowed or bent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use describing the production of a curved or bent shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become bowed or bent; of a thing, a person, or the moon when near the change of phase.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: When applied to a person, it may describe bending in the back; the personal use is figurative or descriptive of posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To put one's bow upon one's back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with قَوْسَهُ, distinct from the intransitive sense of becoming bent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow the way of one's father and imitate him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed figurative use, expressed in the construction يَقْتَاسُ بِأَبِيهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cubit or unit of linear measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A metonymic measurement use explained by the fact that a thing is measured with the arm or bow; it is broader than the fixed Quranic expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The measure or length of a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A measurement expression using the variant form قِيسُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figurative bow idioms: being beyond another's power to compete with; being united against someone; and becoming the best arrow of a little bow, meaning rising from a low condition or returning to favored conduct.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are conventional proverbial expressions rather than literal descriptions of a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Sagittarius, the ninth sign of the zodiac.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional astronomical or astrological designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The rainbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The two words form an inseparable expression.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow-shaped bodily part, specifically the bowed or bent portion of a man's back or the anterior ribs of a camel.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: These are specialized anatomical uses motivated by the shape of a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bow-shaped remainder or gathered portion of dates in a storage receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may denote what remains in the receptacle, a quarter of it, or a gathered quantity of dates, according to the cited usages.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A maker, hewer, or fashioner of bows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An occupational noun formed from the bow noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having a bowed or bent back.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjective describing bodily posture or shape.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of sand, elevated in the shape of a hoop or ring.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of curved or ring-like elevation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A case or container for a bow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete instrumental noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A horse-course or race-ground, especially the rope or starting line from which horses are released.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term can denote the place of departure or the extended rope used to align the horses before a race.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In the expression عَلَى المِقْوَسِ, a setting in which a person is tried or proved through use, practice, or experience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative extension of the race-starting construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: In عَلَى مِقْوَسٍ, being intent upon defending one's honor or a similar interest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An idiomatic use distinct from the literal race-course meaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bow-shaped or curved, as an eyebrow or a gutter around a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a body part or another object whose form is likened to a bow.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person who is bowed or bent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive use of the participial form for bodily posture.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Having one's bow with oneself.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional construction with قَوْسَهُ, not a description of bodily curvature.

cautions: The Quranic form is the dual inflection قَوْسَيْنِ, while the public headword is the singular قَوْسٌ.
The two-bow and two-cubit renderings are interpretations of the fixed expression قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ; the independent Classical meaning “cubit” is listed separately.
unassigned_or_ambiguous_evidence: Maqayis reports a less-established association of قَوْسٌ and قَاسَ with precedence or surpassing; it is retained as a reported root development rather than asserted as a separate Quranic sense.
